# 3d-scene-mcp

> Build and manipulate 3D scenes from natural language via AI agents.

3d-scene-mcp is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/3d-scene-mcp/blob/HEAD/README.md): install, usage and reference
